program.name: Variety Express
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Under half an hour and never the same: a timed circuit, EMOM, AMRAP or Tabata every day.
program.about: Short, timed and never the same twice. Each day deals one of sixteen kinds of training, push, pull, legs, glutes, kettlebell, HIIT, jumps, boxing, kickboxing, core, balance and more, in a circuit, an EMOM, an AMRAP or a Tabata. The same kind never lands two days running. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Every day different · under 30 minutes, timed formats
